meta.title: NETRA India: who to approach
meta.note: Directory of bodies that can act on AI harm. Every entry is 'to verify' until checked against an official source, except those the project owner has checked. Built Union first, then the six states and UTs named in incidents, then the rest.

bodies.name: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
bodies.can_do: Makes rules under the IT Act, including the Intermediary Rules, issues advisories to platforms, and administers the DPDP Act.
bodies.how_to_report: A policy body, not a complaint desk. For content on a platform, complain to the platform first, then the Grievance Appellate Committee.
bodies.source: Address appeared on the body's official domain in a web search on 2026-10-25; not opened from the build sandbox.

bodies.name: IndiaAI Mission and IndiaAI Safety Institute
bodies.can_do: Runs the IndiaAI Mission. Its AI Safety Institute works on standards, frameworks and guidance; officials have said it will not be a regulator.
bodies.how_to_report: No complaint route.
bodies.source: Address appeared on the body's official domain in a web search on 2026-10-25; not opened from the build sandbox.

bodies.name: Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C), Ministry of Home Affairs
bodies.can_do: Coordinates the national response to cybercrime and supports state and UT police with prevention, detection and investigation.
bodies.how_to_report: Not a direct complaint desk. Report through 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in.

bodies.name: Ministry of Information and Broadcasting
bodies.can_do: Oversees broadcasting and the Digital Media Ethics Code for digital news and online curated content (Part III of the IT Rules 2021).
bodies.how_to_report: Grievances about a digital publisher go first to the publisher, then its self-regulatory body.
bodies.source: Address from researcher knowledge; not yet confirmed against an official source.

bodies.name: Copyright Office (DPIIT)
bodies.can_do: Registers copyright. DPIIT has consulted on AI and copyright.
bodies.how_to_report: Registration only; infringement, including by AI tools, is taken to court.
bodies.source: Address from researcher knowledge; not yet confirmed against an official source.

bodies.name: CERT-In
bodies.can_do: National agency for cyber incident response. Covered entities must report listed cyber incidents within 6 hours (CERT-In Directions, 2022).
bodies.how_to_report: Organisations report incidents to CERT-In. Individuals who lost money should use 1930 or cybercrime.gov.in.
bodies.source: Checked by the project owner against the official site.

bodies.name: National Critical Information Infrastructure Protection Centre (NCIIPC)
bodies.can_do: Protects critical information infrastructure, such as power, banking and telecom systems, and advises their operators.
bodies.how_to_report: For operators of critical systems.
bodies.source: https://nciipc.gov.in did not open when the project owner tried it on 2026-10-25. Removed until a working official address is found.

bodies.name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal and helpline 1930
bodies.can_do: Takes online complaints about all kinds of cybercrime. Complaints are passed to the state or UT police for action.
bodies.how_to_report: Lost money? Call 1930 at once, then file at cybercrime.gov.in. Speed matters for freezing funds.
bodies.source: Checked by the project owner against the official site.

bodies.name: Sanchar Saathi: Chakshu (Department of Telecommunications)
bodies.can_do: Takes reports of suspected fraud calls and messages, such as fake KYC requests, impersonation of officials and sextortion. It does not handle money already lost.
bodies.how_to_report: Report on Sanchar Saathi under Chakshu with a screenshot, how the message came, and the date and time. For money lost, use 1930.
bodies.source: Address appeared on the body's official domain in a web search on 2026-10-25; not opened from the build sandbox.

bodies.name: Platform grievance officer (each platform)
bodies.can_do: Every intermediary must have a grievance officer who deals with complaints and takedown requests under the IT Rules 2021.
bodies.how_to_report: Use the platform's report or grievance form and keep the complaint number.

bodies.name: Grievance Appellate Committee
bodies.can_do: Hears appeals against a platform grievance officer's decision.
bodies.how_to_report: Appeal online within 30 days of the grievance officer's decision.
bodies.source: Checked by the project owner against the official site.

bodies.name: Data Protection Board of India
bodies.can_do: Decides complaints about breaches of the DPDP Act and can impose penalties. Most duties of companies apply from 13 May 2027.
bodies.how_to_report: Complain first to the company's grievance officer, then to the Board online.

bodies.name: Supreme Court of India
bodies.can_do: Hears appeals and writ petitions, including public-interest petitions on fundamental rights.
bodies.how_to_report: Through an advocate; free legal aid is available through legal services authorities.
bodies.source: Checked by the project owner against the official site.

bodies.name: National Legal Services Authority (NALSA)
bodies.can_do: Arranges free legal aid and lawyers for eligible people, including women, children and people below an income limit, in any court.
bodies.how_to_report: Call 15100 or approach the nearest legal services authority.
bodies.source: Address appeared on the body's official domain in a web search on 2026-10-25; not opened from the build sandbox.

bodies.name: National Human Rights Commission
bodies.can_do: Inquires into complaints of human rights violations by public servants and recommends relief.
bodies.how_to_report: See the Commission's website for complaint routes.
bodies.source: Address from researcher knowledge; not yet confirmed against an official source.

bodies.name: National Commission for Women
bodies.can_do: Takes complaints about violations of women's rights, including online abuse.
bodies.how_to_report: Helpline 14490 (24×7). Online complaint at ncwapps.nic.in, or email complaintcell-ncw@nic.in.
bodies.source: Address appeared on the body's official domain in a web search on 2026-10-25; not opened from the build sandbox.

bodies.name: National Commission for Protection of Child Rights
bodies.can_do: Protects child rights and takes complaints about violations of children's rights.
bodies.how_to_report: See the Commission's website for complaint routes.
bodies.source: Address from researcher knowledge; not yet confirmed against an official source.

bodies.name: National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
bodies.can_do: Highest consumer commission. Hears the largest consumer claims and appeals from state commissions.
bodies.how_to_report: Online filing portal to verify (reports differ on e-Daakhil and e-Jagriti).
bodies.source: Address from researcher knowledge; not yet confirmed against an official source.

bodies.name: Central Consumer Protection Authority
bodies.can_do: Can investigate unfair trade practices and false or misleading advertisements, including deepfake endorsements, and act under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 (ss.10 and 21).
bodies.how_to_report: Complaints usually start with the National Consumer Helpline (1915).

bodies.name: National Consumer Helpline
bodies.can_do: Helps consumers settle complaints with a company before going to a consumer commission.
bodies.how_to_report: Call 1915 or register on the helpline's portal.
bodies.source: Address appeared on the body's official domain in a web search on 2026-10-25; not opened from the build sandbox.

bodies.name: Election Commission of India
bodies.can_do: Enforces the Model Code of Conduct in Lok Sabha and Assembly elections, including directions on AI-generated campaign content.
bodies.how_to_report: Complain through the Commission's website or its complaint apps.
bodies.source: Checked by the project owner against the official site.

bodies.name: Reserve Bank of India
bodies.can_do: Regulates banks and payment systems. Its FREE-AI committee report makes recommendations on AI in finance.
bodies.how_to_report: Complain to your bank first; if it does not resolve the complaint within 30 days, go to the RBI Ombudsman.
bodies.source: Address appeared on the body's official domain in a web search on 2026-10-25; not opened from the build sandbox.

bodies.name: Securities and Exchange Board of India
bodies.can_do: Regulates securities markets; has consulted on guidelines for AI and machine-learning use by market intermediaries.
bodies.how_to_report: Complaints against market intermediaries go through SEBI's SCORES system.
bodies.source: Address from researcher knowledge; not yet confirmed against an official source.

bodies.name: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India
bodies.can_do: Regulates insurers and insurance intermediaries.
bodies.how_to_report: Complain to the insurer first, then through IRDAI's grievance system.
bodies.source: Address from researcher knowledge; not yet confirmed against an official source.

bodies.name: Telecom Regulatory Authority of India
bodies.can_do: Regulates telecom services, including rules on unsolicited commercial calls and messages.
bodies.how_to_report: Spam calls and messages are reported to your telecom operator (1909).
bodies.source: Address from researcher knowledge; not yet confirmed against an official source.

bodies.name: Competition Commission of India
bodies.can_do: Investigates anti-competitive conduct, including by digital platforms.
bodies.how_to_report: See the Commission's website for how to file information.
bodies.source: Address from researcher knowledge; not yet confirmed against an official source.

bodies.name: Indian Council of Medical Research
bodies.can_do: Issued ethical guidelines for AI in biomedical research and healthcare.
bodies.how_to_report: No complaint route for individuals.
bodies.source: Address from researcher knowledge; not yet confirmed against an official source.

bodies.name: Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation
bodies.can_do: Regulates drugs and medical devices; software used as a medical device may fall under it.
bodies.how_to_report: See the organisation's website.
bodies.source: https://cdsco.gov.in did not open when the project owner tried it on 2026-10-25. Removed until a working official address is found.

bodies.name: Bureau of Indian Standards
bodies.can_do: Sets national standards, including standards on AI.
bodies.how_to_report: No complaint route for AI harm.
bodies.source: Address from researcher knowledge; not yet confirmed against an official source.

bodies.name: Telecommunication Engineering Centre
bodies.can_do: Telecom standards body; published a standard for assessing and rating the fairness of AI systems.
bodies.how_to_report: No complaint route.
bodies.source: Address from researcher knowledge; not yet confirmed against an official source.

bodies.name: PIB Fact Check
bodies.can_do: Checks and debunks false claims about the Union government, including deepfakes of officials.
bodies.how_to_report: Send the claim to PIB Fact Check through its website.
bodies.source: Link supplied and opened by the project owner on 2026-10-25. It is the PIB site; PIB Fact Check is a unit of PIB.
